source: Canonical clause taxonomy as supplied by the engagement manager on 2026-09-18. Names, definitions and aliases are verbatim. An alias written as an object carries a parenthetical from the source: 'match' is the surface form a document would contain, 'note' is the parenthetical, and 'literal': false marks a sense restriction that is prompt guidance only and never a lookup key.

types.name: Definitions & Interpretation
types.definition: Defined terms and the rules for reading the agreement (singular/plural, headings not affecting meaning, "including" non-exhaustive, reference conventions).

types.name: Purpose & Scope of Services
types.definition: What the supplier is engaged to do at the master level — the subject matter and outer boundary of the engagement. Excludes how well it must be performed (→ 5) and the mechanism for ordering work (→ 3).

excludes.note: how well it must be performed

types.name: Statements of Work & Work Orders
types.definition: The mechanism by which specific work is ordered under the MSA — form, execution, incorporation, precedence of SOWs, and the master/order relationship.

types.name: Customer Obligations
types.definition: Duties binding the customer/client — access, facilities, information, timely decisions, dependencies, and consequences of customer delay.

types.name: Service Provider Obligations
types.definition: Duties and performance standards binding the supplier — standard of care, skill and diligence, resourcing, cooperation. Excludes measurable SLA metrics (→ 9) and legal compliance duties (→ 21).

types.name: Governance & Project Management
types.definition: Joint management machinery — steering committees, relationship managers, review meetings, reporting cadence, escalation ladders below formal dispute resolution.

types.name: Term & Renewal
types.definition: When the agreement starts, how long it runs, and how it extends — commencement/effective date, initial term, renewal terms, auto-renewal, non-renewal notice. Excludes early exit (→ 26).

types.name: Deliverables & Acceptance
types.definition: Identification of work product to be handed over and the testing, review, acceptance, rejection and deemed-acceptance process.

types.name: Service Levels
types.definition: Measurable performance targets and the consequences of missing them — availability, response/resolution times, service credits, earn-back, chronic failure.

types.name: Support & Maintenance
types.definition: Ongoing sustainment of delivered services or software — helpdesk, incident severity handling, bug fixes, patches, upgrades, maintenance windows, end-of-life.

types.name: Change Control
types.definition: The formal process for varying scope, price or timeline of the services — change requests, impact assessment, change orders, authority to approve. Excludes amendments to the MSA itself (→ 35).

types.name: Fees & Payment
types.definition: All money flowing to the supplier and the mechanics of it — rates, rate cards, pricing models, invoicing, payment terms, late payment interest, disputed invoices, reimbursable expenses, taxes, withholding and gross-up, set-off.

types.name: Confidentiality
types.definition: Definition of confidential information and the obligations of non-disclosure, permitted use, permitted recipients, exclusions, compelled disclosure, and return/destruction. Excludes personal data (→ 14) and trade secret ownership (→ 16).

types.name: Data Protection & Privacy
types.definition: Legal and regulatory obligations regarding personal data — controller/processor roles, lawful processing, data subject rights, cross-border transfer, breach notification, DPA incorporation, sub-processor consent.

types.name: Information Security & Data Management
types.definition: Technical and organisational controls protecting systems and data — encryption, access control, vulnerability and penetration testing, security standards and certifications, data location, retention, backup, deletion and return of data.

types.name: Intellectual Property
types.definition: Ownership and allocation of IP — background vs foreground IP, work product ownership, assignment, licences granted, residuals, feedback, open-source, moral rights, third-party IP.

types.name: Representations & Warranties
types.definition: Statements of fact and promises of quality given by either party — authority to contract, non-infringement, service conformity, warranty period and remedy, and disclaimers of implied warranties.

types.name: Indemnification
types.definition: One party's obligation to defend, hold harmless and pay third-party claims — IP infringement, data breach, personal injury, and the indemnity procedure (notice, control of defence, settlement, mitigation).

types.name: Limitation of Liability
types.definition: Monetary caps, liability baskets, exclusions of indirect/consequential/special loss, lost profits and data, super-caps and carve-outs from the cap.

types.name: Insurance
types.definition: Required policies, minimum coverage limits, insurer ratings, additional insured / waiver of subrogation, certificates of insurance, notice of cancellation.

types.name: Compliance with Laws
types.definition: Standing duty to comply with applicable law and with sector-specific regulation — anti-bribery, sanctions and export control, modern slavery, anti-money laundering, regulator cooperation and right of examination.

types.name: Audit & Records
types.definition: Rights to inspect, examine and audit the other party's books, systems and facilities, plus the duty to create and retain records for a stated period.

types.name: Personnel
types.definition: Human resources assigned to the engagement — key personnel, named individuals, background checks and vetting, training, removal and replacement, continuity of staff, non-solicitation and no-hire.

types.name: Subcontracting & Sub-processors
types.definition: Delegation of performance to third-party entities — prior consent, approved lists, flow-down of terms, and prime contractor liability for subcontractor acts.

types.name: Business Continuity & Disaster Recovery
types.definition: Resilience planning against disruption — BCP/DR plans, RTO/RPO, failover, testing frequency, invocation and continuity of service during a disaster.

types.name: Suspension & Termination
types.definition: Ending or pausing the agreement before natural expiry — suspension rights, termination for convenience, for cause, for material breach with cure period, for insolvency, for change of control, plus the immediate consequences of termination (cessation of work, final invoicing, return of property, survival of terms).

types.name: Exit & Transition Assistance
types.definition: The forward-looking wind-down programme — exit plan, transition services after termination, knowledge transfer, migration to a successor supplier, handover of data and assets, transition charges.

types.name: Assignment & Novation
types.definition: Transfer of the agreement or rights under it to another entity — consent requirements, permitted transfers to affiliates or on merger, novation, binding effect on successors.

types.name: Force Majeure
types.definition: Relief from performance due to events beyond reasonable control — definition of qualifying events, notice, mitigation, suspension of obligations, and termination if prolonged.

types.name: Governing Law & Dispute Resolution
types.definition: The law applying to the contract and the machinery for resolving disputes — negotiation/escalation, mediation, arbitration seat and rules, litigation, exclusive or non-exclusive jurisdiction, venue, jury waiver, injunctive relief.

types.name: Notices
types.definition: How formal communications are given — permitted methods, addresses and contacts, when notice is deemed received, and updates to notice details.

types.name: Order of Precedence
types.definition: Ranking of contract documents when they conflict — MSA vs SOW vs schedules vs purchase orders vs supplier terms.

types.name: Independent Contractor
types.definition: The legal relationship between the parties — independent contractor status, no partnership/joint venture/agency/employment, no authority to bind, responsibility for own taxes and employees.

types.name: Publicity & Use of Name
types.definition: Control over external communications — press releases, use of names, logos and trademarks, customer references, case studies, marketing and analyst mentions.

types.name: General Provisions
types.definition: Residual boilerplate with no dedicated type — amendments and modifications to the MSA, waiver, severability, entire agreement/integration, no third-party beneficiaries, counterparts and electronic signature, further assurances, cumulative remedies, headings.

types.name: Agreement Identification
types.definition: The title, contract type and date of the instrument, typically on the cover page or opening line.

types.name: Party Identification
types.definition: Naming and describing the contracting entities — legal names, incorporation details, registered addresses, defined short names ("Supplier", "Customer").

types.name: Preamble
types.definition: The introductory sentence binding the parties and the date into an agreement, before any recital. Typically "This Master Services Agreement is made and entered into as of … by and between …".

types.name: Recitals
types.definition: Background and context narrative explaining why the parties are contracting, usually WHEREAS-form, closing with a NOW THEREFORE consideration statement.

types.name: Table of Contents
types.definition: Navigational index of clauses, schedules and page numbers.

types.name: Signature Block
types.definition: The execution apparatus — signature lines, signatory name/title/date, "IN WITNESS WHEREOF" wording, company seals, witness and attestation blocks.
aliases: Signed for and on behalf of

types.name: Schedule & Exhibit Identification
types.definition: Headers and cover markers that identify an annexed document, without themselves containing obligations.

aliases.alias: Statement of Work (as a cover header)

types.name: Page Furniture
types.definition: Repeating page-level artefacts — running headers and footers, page numbers, document control IDs, version stamps, confidentiality watermarks.

types.name: Notes & References
types.definition: Footnotes, endnotes, drafting notes and cross-reference apparatus sitting outside the operative text.

types.name: Template Placeholder
types.definition: Unfilled template fields and bracketed instructions left in the document.

types.name: Other Non-Clause Content
types.definition: Any structural, layout or residual text that is not an operative provision and fits none of the above — stray fragments, OCR artefacts, orphaned headings, blank-section markers.
